name: Can I replace my kitchen faucet myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my kitchen faucet myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing a kitchen faucet can be a DIY project for those with basic plumbing knowledge and tools. However, improper installation can lead to leaks, water damage, or issues with water pressure. For peace of mind, especially if you're unsure or encounter unexpected problems, hiring a professional ensures the job is done correctly, adhering to all standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: While possible for DIY, professional installation prevents leaks, water damage, and ensures proper functionality.
